Jake (Support): FYI, NovaRetail trial account is hitting repeated 429s on embed ingest since 09:40 UTC. Support marked it P1 and handed up to CS for priority handling. Logs attached below.
Maria (CSM): Ack. Is this impacting onboarding demo later today?
Jake (Support): Yes — QA reported failures in the onboarding flow. Demo at 15:00 customer local.
Elaine (CS Ops): Can you paste the error snippet?
Jake (Support): ```
2026-03-23T09:38:12Z ERROR ingest: request_id=abc123 status=429 reason=rate_limit exceeded quota_remaining=0
2026-03-23T09:38:20Z ERROR ingest: request_id=abc124 status=429 reason=batch window overflow
```
Omar (SRE): Seeing a short spike in prefix key churn from that tenant, concurrent writes ballooned. I can temporarily bump quotas on dedicated pool while we investigate.
Maria (CSM): Please do the bump if it removes demo risk. Also need a comms plan — customer will expect status before 14:30.
Elaine (CS Ops): Proposed comms: 1) Quick apology + short RCA (root cause unknown) 2) Temporary workaround (quota bump + recommend batching) 3) Next steps and ETA for permanent fix. Can someone draft a one-paragraph status?
Jake (Support): Draft: "Hi NovaRetail — we\u2019ve identified transient rate limits causing their embed jobs to fail. We\u2019ve applied a temporary quota increase and recommend batching requests to reduce bursts. Our SREs are investigating root cause; we\u2019ll follow up with an ETA within 2 hours."
Maria (CSM): Good start — add "we're prioritizing your demo and will confirm by 14:00".
Jake (Support): Updated: "...we're prioritizing your demo and will confirm by 14:00 UTC."
Omar (SRE): Quota bumped on pool redwood-dedicated-3 by +30% for tenant nova-retail. Monitoring now; 429s have dropped in the last 2m.
Oncall Bot: Incident created -> INC-2026-033-48 assigned to Omar.
Elaine (CS Ops): Ok, immediate mitigation done. Maria — recommend you send the status note and offer a short 10-min pre-demo sync with product engineer? That helps regain confidence.
Maria (CSM): Will send now. Also flagging renewal watch: NovaRetail is on a monthly trial with high ARR potential; churn risk if demo fails. I'll note this in the account health doc.
Jake (Support): FYI, customer reported they were retrying aggressively which worsened the burst. Can we include a polite ask to avoid hammering the endpoint?
Maria (CSM): Yes — I'll include a line: "please pause automated retries for the next hour while we stabilize".
Elaine (CS Ops): Action items: - Maria send status to customer (by 13:45) - Omar follow post-mortem and revert quota when safe - Jake add retry guidance to support KB - CS Ops to update account health and renewal-risk tag.
Maria (CSM): Sending the note now. Pasting below before I hit send — feedback welcome:
"Hi Marco — quick update: we identified transient rate limits affecting your embed jobs. We applied a temporary quota increase and our SREs are monitoring; 429 errors have dropped. Please pause automated retries for 60 minutes while we stabilize. We\u2019re prioritizing your demo and will confirm readiness by 14:00 UTC. Apologies for the disruption — Maria, CSM (Redwood)."
Jake (Support): LGTM :thumbsup:
Omar (SRE): I'll keep INC open and post interim findings in 45m. If errors reappear, escalate to runtime lead.
Elaine (CS Ops): I'll add a renewal-risk note and tag finance and solutions-engineering for a post-demo follow-up.
Maria (CSM): Call booked with customer at 14:10 local for a quick pre-demo check. Thanks team — will update thread after send. :pray:
Jake (Support): Thanks — marking this as escalated -> CS priority.
Maria (CSM): Sent. Thread closed for now; will re-open if anything changes.
